To solve this problem, we need to consider the possible combinations of digits in the 8-digit display for the date in 2023.

Each digit in the 8-digit display can appear either an even number of times or an odd number of times. For a date to have each digit appear an even number of times, the year, month, and day must all have an even number of digits.

In 2023, the year is 2023, which has 4 digits, all of which appear an even number of times. The month can be any value from 01 to 12, all of which have an even number of digits. The day can be any value from 01 to 31, and all of these values have an even number of digits.

Therefore, the number of dates in 2023 where each digit appears an even number of times in the 8-digit display is the number of combinations of year, month, and day that satisfy this condition.

The number of possible years is 1, the number of possible months is 12, and the number of possible days is 31. Therefore, the total number of dates is 1 × 12 × 31 = 372.

The correct answer is (C) 7.
